comment: All eight drum machines share one implementation, src/drum_machine_base.hh. The Length and Speed jacks carry no printing; the manual's opening section says every unlabelled jack is the CV input for the parameter beside it. Two things the manual does not say. The Length knob is configured as a percentage from 0 to 100 (line 74), but line 98 clamps the knob to a floor of 0.1 and line 99 then maps 0.1..1.0 onto 0.19..1.0 of the sample, so fully left plays 19% of the sample, not none of it. And line 141 advances the playback position by the speed ratio alone, with no conversion against the engine sample rate, where the one-shot modules divide by it (one_shot_base.hh:118); an engine at 48kHz therefore plays these samples sharp. The Sum knob scales only the Sum output; individual outputs are set at line 137 before it is applied.
